newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-RODA, HEERENVEEN SEEK FIRST DUTCH CUP TRIUMPH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RODA, HEERENVEEN SEEK FIRST DUTCH CUP TRIUMPH.

text.p: Roda JC Kerkrade and Heerenveen will both bid for their first Dutch Cup title when they meet in the final in Rotterdam on Thursday.
Roda have been in the final three times before, losing every time.
Heerenveen have only reached the final once, in 1993, when they were thrashed 6-2 by Ajax Amsterdam.

The match pits teams from north and south against one another and features two of the most highly-rated strikers in the Netherlands -- Heerenveen's Jon Dahl Tomasson, the league's top scorer with 18 goals, and Roda's Gerald Sibon.
Sibon will leave Roda at the end of the season for Ajax. He may be joined there by Tomasson, although the Dane is also believed to be a target for Newcastle and Barcelona.
There has been little to choose between the teams' league performances this season. Heerenveen are sixth in the table, one point ahead of seventh placed Roda.
Roda, who have qualified for Europe before, are a hard working team with a powerful defence and midfield. They tend to rely on feeding Sibon to score goals from counter-attacks.

Heerenveen, who beat Feyenoord on the way to the final, are a more openly attacking side with the creative flair of former Russia and Barcelona striker Igor Korneev. He is due to join Feyenoord next season.
Heerenveen seem set to win the battle of the fans.
Some 25,000 fanatical Freisians are due to make the trip to Rotterdam compared with a modest 12,000 Roda supporters, even though the distance to travel is the same for both sets of supporters.

Heerenveen - Hans Vonk, Borre Meinseth, Ole Tobiassen, Johan Hansma, Ton Sier, Alex Pastoor, Jon Dahl Tomasson, Igor Korneev, Jeffrey Talan, Leroy Echteld, Boudewijn Pahlplatz
